body.name: priorityH
body.def: \(\mathfrak P_H\) recomputes its action solely from the current encoded state. It scans actually present supported-context gate occurrences first; then, for the least task, tests terminal marginalization, nonancestor restriction or intervention augmentation, multiple-district splitting, and the one-district prescribed-complement recursion in that order; only the resulting recursive terminal/failure state is residual-ready. Fixed input orders break ties. No published trace or verifier outcome is an agenda input.
